title: Blueberry Popovers
description: This special blueberry popover recipe will add a lot of flavor to your next brunch.
ingredients: 0.25 cup confectioners' sugar, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Place a piece of butter into each cup of a jumbo muffin tin.
Place muffin tin into the preheating oven until butter melts, about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Stir 1 tablespoon sugar and cinnamon together in a small bowl.

Beat milk, 1/4 cup sugar, eggs, and vanilla in a large bowl. Whisk in flour until incorporated. Divide batter among muffin cups. Drop an equal amount of blueberries into each cup, then sprinkle cinnamon-sugar mixture over top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 5 minutes. Reduce the heat to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) and continue baking until popovers are no longer moist in the center, about 25 minutes.
Remove from the oven and transfer to a wire rack. Dust tops of popovers with confectioners' sugar and squeeze lemon halves over top. Serve warm.

video.description: Make brunch or weekend breakfast extra special with these rich and delicious popovers. This easy recipe begins with melting butter in a muffin tin. Create the popover batter with milk, eggs, sugar, vanilla and flour. Divide the batter along with blueberries over each melted butter portion, then top with a sprinkling of cinnamon and sugar. Bake until beautifully puffed up, then serve with a dusting of confectioners’ sugar and a spritz of lemon juice for the ultimate in comforting good flavors.
